theorems.name: Submission.ecf_im_lipschitz_parametrization
theorems.statement: ∀ (k P : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), IsIntegerMultiplicity S → IsCompact S.support → S.mass ≠ ∞ ∧ ∃ (F : ℕ → Euclid k → Euclid P) (A : ℕ → Set (Euclid k)) (g : ℕ → Euclid k → ℤ), (∀ j, ∃ K : NNReal, LipschitzWith K (F j)) ∧ (∀ j, MeasurableSet (A j)) ∧ (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) ∧ (∀ j, IntegrableOn (fun u => (g j u : ℝ)) (A j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ u ∈ A j, DifferentiableAt ℝ (F j) u) ∧ (∀ j, F j '' A j ⊆ S.support) ∧ ∑' j, ∫⁻ u in A j, ‖(g j u : ℝ)‖ₑ * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun a b : Fin k => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1)) (fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single b 1))))) ≠ ∞ ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, HasSum (fun j => ∫ u in A j, (g j u : ℝ) * (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) (F j u) (fun a => fderiv ℝ (F j) u (EuclideanSpace.single a 1))) (S ω)
